summary: CometAPI (an OpenAI-compatible multi-model API gateway) credits new accounts $0.1 USD in the Wallet after register and login, with no extra claim step. Docs describe pay-as-you-go top-ups via Stripe with a $10 minimum; they do not require a card to receive the signup credit.
claim_steps: Register and log in to CometAPI.
Open the Wallet page; the $0.1 USD credit is applied automatically.
Create an API token under Tokens to call supported models via api.cometapi.com.

social_proof.title: Configure CometAPI account, billing, and base URL
social_proof.text: How to claim the $0.1 USD credit? No special operation required. After registering and logging in, you can see the $0.1 USD credit in your Wallet page.
